card.title: PlayStation 5 3 beeps when power is plugged in

source.title: PlayStation 5 3 beeps when power is plugged in

symptoms: 3 beeps when AC is plugged in

claims.statement: PS5 beeping 3 times on AC plug-in is a NOR/BIOS (25Q16JVNIM) problem; first try clearing the error log over UART ('errlog clear'), because a full DBI section can cause it.
Otherwise remove the BIOS chip, dump it, and run it through PS5 NOR Editor (pre-configured board type, harvest all options) before writing it back.

procedure: Connect UART and clear error codes.
If unresolved, remove BIOS chip (next to southbridge) and dump it.
Repair the dump with PS5 NOR Editor harvest.
Write back, resolder, test PSN and a game.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
